attchmntText: Prakash Pipes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Sachin Ghanghas as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Prakash Pipes Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Net profit for the half year was 3,250 lakh rupees, compared to 1,967 lakh rupees in the previous year. Revenue from operations for the half year stood at 50,053 lakh rupees. The Board appointed Shri Sachin Ghanghas as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with immediate effect. Smt. Priyanka Agarwal was appointed as Additional Director and Independent Director for five years, effective 1st December 2026, subject to shareholder approval. Shri Amitava Ray was appointed as Additional Director and Whole-time Director for three years, effective 1st December 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Prakash Pipes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release ".
voiceSummary: Prakash Pipes Limited filed a press release regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Net sales for the quarter reached Rs. 259 crores, up 43% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 28 crores, a 70% increase. Profit after Tax stood at Rs. 16 crores, up 72%. For the half year, net sales were Rs. 501 crores, up 30%. EBITDA was Rs. 55 crores, up 58%. Profit after Tax was Rs. 33 crores, up 65%. Earnings per share for the half year were Rs. 13.59. The PVC Pipes and Fittings division recorded sales volume of 10,773 MT. The Flexible Packaging division achieved sales volume of 5,549 MT, a 38% growth. The company noted resin price stabilization but warned of geopolitical impacts. Expansion in production capacity is underway for the Flexible Packaging division.
